name: kibi-runtime
description: Narrow first-party runtime contracts and adapters for Kibi operations.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && bun build src/index.ts --outfile dist/index.js --target node --format esm --packages bundle --external kibi-cli --external kibi-core --external kibi-plugin-builtin && bun build ../cli/src/engine-daemon.ts --outfile dist/engine-daemon.js --target node --format esm --packages bundle --external kibi-core && rm -rf dist/skills && mkdir -p dist/skills && cp -r src/skills/. dist/skills/

author: Piotr Franczyk
